summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, reporting its June 2026 monthly revenue, along with updates on funds lent to other parties, endorsements and guarantees, and financial derivative transactions. Net sales for June were NT$23.12 billion, a 22.85% increase year-over-year, and year-to-date sales rose 11.28%. No special situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present; the filing is a routine operational update under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms or board actions regarding a corporate transaction are disclosed.
